title: Don't miss the $1,000,000 Film Festival
description:
The $1,000,000 Higgsfield Global Film Festival is officially open for submissions.

Judged by an Oscar-winning jury.
Make a 3-5 min AI film in any genre, solo or with a team of up to 4.

Submissions close September 3.
